capture.stat_positive: Important: IV points ×2. Prefer a nature boost.
capture.stat_neutral: Neutral: IV points ×1. Nature may raise or lower this stat.
capture.stat_negative: Less important: IV points ×0.5. Prefer the nature penalty here.
capture.stat_preferences_help: Important ×2, neutral ×1, less important ×0.5. All IVs contribute, including those below your preferred quality. HP is never changed by nature. If no beneficial nature is possible, neutral natures are used.
capture.search_time_help: Real search time for the whole worker pool. Starts once every worker is ready; travel and catching the winner are separate. At the limit, catch the highest-scoring candidate that meets all mandatory filters. A perfect candidate may finish early.
capture.invalid_stat_preferences: Choose important, neutral or less important for all six stats.
capture.invalid_exact_ivs: Minimum IVs require an on/off value.
capture.invalid_search_time: Search time must be an integer from 1 to 86400 seconds.
capture.budget_no_candidate: Time is up. No candidate met all mandatory filters. Search paused; saved alternatives remain available.
capture.hp_stat_help: HP IV points ×{weight}. Nature never raises or lowers HP.
capture.exact_ivs_help: These are required minima, not exact equalities. Higher IVs still improve quality. If no candidate qualifies before time runs out, the search pauses without catching a different Pokémon.
party_edit.stopped_hint: Party change stopped. Completed transfers remain. Close any open game menu and apply the reviewed draft again to finish, or load the pre-bot backup with F8 to undo.
